responsibility: Implements C++ constant-expression and constexpr evaluation in the front end. It validates constexpr functions and objects, stores constexpr function definitions for later interpretation, evaluates expressions and calls under constexpr rules, distinguishes potential/required/static-init constant expressions, tracks non-constant and overflow conditions for diagnostics, and exposes the predicates used by parsing, templates, and initialization code to decide whether expressions may be folded or are valid in constant-evaluation contexts.
